User is buying a home for $325,000 and says they received Wells Fargo preapproval for $400,000. Seller agreed to a $2,000 closing-cost credit; user plans to request an additional 1% ($3,250), potentially totaling $5,250, depending on market and inspection issues. Inspection found minor roof/plumbing issues. Prior rough closing estimates were $11,332–$20,322, with estimated buyer out-of-pocket costs of $6,082–$15,072 if the full $5,250 credit is granted, subject to lender rules and actual expenses. Prior housing illustration assumed $300,000 financed (25% down), 30-year fixed at 4%: about $1,432 P&I, $339 property tax (1.25%), and $217 insurance (0.8%), totaling about $1,987/month; actual details are still needed.

User lives in ZIP 78749 (Austin, Texas area) and is arranging cable/TV, electricity (TXU, Reliant, Direct Energy, Just Energy, or Pulse), and gas (likely Texas Gas Service); pricing/availability needs verification. They chose Trello for move organization. They plan to schedule a Liberty Mutual home insurance policy and should review coverage limits, deductibles, exclusions (especially flood/water damage), RCV vs ACV, liability, personal property, additional living expense
